agents.name: Partner
agents.description: Leads the crew. Responsible for framing the real goal, deciding which specialist owns each piece, coordinating handoffs, and keeping the work moving until you're satisfied. Start here by default.

agents.name: Coding Agent
agents.description: Implements changes in the codebase. Responsible for reading and editing code, debugging stack traces and unexpected behavior, writing tests, refactoring, and shipping a fix end-to-end.

agents.name: Product Agent
agents.description: Turns fuzzy ideas into a shippable scope. Responsible for naming the real user and problem, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, separating must-ship from nice-to-have, and making tradeoffs explicit.

agents.name: Designer
agents.description: Designs how the product looks and feels. Responsible for layouts, interaction states (loading, empty, error, success), typography, copy review, and visual critique of existing screens.
